$comment: D-PP-STRINGIZE-EXPANDED-ARG-SLICES-WRONG-BYTES witness. `#` (C 6.10.3.2 / C23 6.10.5.2) must spell its operand's PREPROCESSING TOKENS, not a contiguous source byte range: once the operand arrived through a macro expansion its tokens come from the `#define` line, the call site and the product buffer interleaved, and slicing across them silently shipped the define line's own text, a comment, or the rest of the file. Eighteen runtime checks plus four printed lines; every expectation MEASURED on clang-18, clang-19, gcc-13 `-std=c2x` and cl 19.51.36252 `/Zc:preprocessor`, all four agreeing. The load-bearing pair is `XSTR(PLAIN(1,2))` -> `g(1, 2)` against its single-level control `STR(PLAIN(1,2))` -> `PLAIN(1,2)`, and `S(f("a  b" ,   "c  d"))`, which collapses white space BETWEEN tokens while preserving it INSIDE one in the same product. The `release` arm re-runs the whole thing through the shipped optimizer. Exit 42; each check has a distinct failure code.
